description: Defines a font resolver class for SegoeWP fonts, mapping font requests to specific font files embedded as resources, and resolving font face information based on family name, bold, and italic attributes.

classes.name: SegoeWpFontResolver
classes.description: Implements IFontResolver to map SegoeWP font requests to embedded font resources and resolve font typefaces.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a font face based on family name, bold, and italic flags, returning font info or null.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves font file bytes for a given face name from embedded resources.
